description:
This plugin allows users to sign in through an SSO provider (such as Google, Facebook, or your own provider). This enables one-click signin.
Review documentation at https://github.com/9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso
name: SSO Authentication
overview: Authenticate users against an SSO provider.

versions.changelog:
5.0.0.0: Jellyfin 12 support (.NET 10, ABI 12.0.0.0); stop using the legacy
  X-Emby-Authorization header, which Jellyfin 12 ignores by default; refresh the
  bundled jellyfin-apiclient to 1.11.0; drop the vulnerable System.Security.Cryptography.Xml
  package reference. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer -- use 4.1.1.0 on Jellyfin 10.11.
4.1.1.0: Add admin UI for user mappings (canonical links), fix apiClient device name stub, test infrastructure
4.1.0.0: Security hardening - fix XSS, SSRF, CSRF, race conditions, SAML validation; add automated tests
4.0.0.4: Fix security issue in SAML
4.0.0.0: Jellyfin 10.11
3.5.3.0: Allow for OID-provided avatars, various bugfixes and workarounds
3.5.2.4: Updates for Jellyfin 10.9
